fact: A representative of the Communications Minister said at the Ghana AI Summit that government was preparing a Data Harmonisation Act (data governance and classification standards across public institutions) and that a proposed Data Exchange Act (a bill, not an act in force) would improve interoperability and facilitate secure data sharing among government agencies.

NITA's draft NITA Data Harmonisation Bill 2025 (a bill, not yet law) would give a legal basis for data sharing, standardisation and system integration across public and private institutions; public consultation was set for 19 to 27 November 2025, then Cabinet and Parliament.
